name: a calendar switched on while a deletion waits for confirmation: its events are spared by their markers alone
notes: §3 v1.10: every row a Calendar pass stores as a first sighting gets a first-look marker (a gcal.event entry of the same observer and account: window = the row's occurredAt, a point; lastSyncAt = changesSince = the row's first sighting), stored with the row even when the pass records no window.

Story. acct-b first looked at the week at 13:30 (complete: changesSince = lastSyncAt = 13:30). At 14:10 its next pass sees 'Board dinner' missing for the first time and the 'Family' calendar newly shown. A complete pass that saw an event missing for the first time records no coverage until a later pass confirms or clears the deletion (§3), and a change in the shown calendars breaks the run of followed changes. So the 14:10 pass records no window; it stores the Family calendar's events as first sightings at 14:10, each with its marker. The user then closes the tab.

Coverage. acct-a follows the week [10-04 00:00, 10-11 00:00]: changesSince 09:00, last synced 14:20. acct-b's first look: the week, changesSince = lastSyncAt = 13:30, allCalendars false (Family was not shown yet; §3: true only if every calendar was visible). acct-b's marker for o1: window [10-09 18:00, 10-09 18:00], changesSince = lastSyncAt = 14:10. No claims.

o1 'Family dinner' (10-09 18:00), first seen 14:10: acct-a's entry satisfies rule (a) (09:00 < 14:10 ≤ 14:20). acct-b's first look began comparing at 13:30 ≠ 14:10 and has changesSince, so it does not find o1 already there; the marker began comparing at 14:10, o1's first sighting: rule (b) fails. Not an orphan → no receipt.

Without the marker, o1 would be an orphan, and anchored at 14:10 muse's session at 14:08 (4000) and idle [14:05, 14:12] covering [14:08, 14:10] (3000) give 7/10 → a false UNASKED for an event that was on the Family calendar all along (Hard Rule 7).

o2 'Team lunch' (10-07 12:30), first seen 14:20 by acct-a's pass: rule (a) through acct-a (09:00 < 14:20 ≤ 14:20); acct-b's first look began comparing at 13:30 ≠ 14:20, and the marker does not hold 10-07 12:30 → an orphan. Anchor 14:20: muse's session at 14:18 (4000), idle [14:15, 14:25] covers [14:18, 14:20] (3000) → 7/10 → UNASKED, reasons unasked.session, unasked.idle.
o2 finality (§7): muse's adapter synced 15:00 ≥ 14:20 + 2 + 30 min = 14:52 → FINAL (evaluatedAt 15:30).
